The '''Vondarc system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vondarc/Legends|Vondarc]]. It was one of the endpoints of the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]].
